post.summary: Remove a User's Profile Photo as a moderator
post.description: Shows the User's Assigned Avatar again. With reportId, a pending report on that User becomes actioned in the same transaction. Writes a USER_PHOTO_REMOVE audit entry.

400.description: Invalid request, or the report is not about this User

403.description: Not an elevated admin, moderation actions disabled, or the target cannot be moderated

409.description: The User has no photo, or the report is already resolved

403.description: Feature disabled or self-contact not allowed

get.summary: Read one conversation with the viewer's send restriction

200.description: Conversation summary plus sendRestriction (null when a message would be accepted)

403.description: Feature disabled or not a participant

400.description: Validation error, or RATE_LIMITED with details (RateLimitedDetails): reason destination_limit, ip_limit or backoff, and retryInSeconds

403.description: Suspended User: FORBIDDEN with details.reason USER_SUSPENDED; no code consumption or Session issuance

401.description: Invalid, expired or revoked refresh token

403.description: Suspended User: FORBIDDEN with details.reason USER_SUSPENDED; no Session rotation

post.summary: Request a code to add or replace a Sign-in Method

400.description: Validation error, or RATE_LIMITED with details (RateLimitedDetails): reason destination_limit, ip_limit or backoff, and retryInSeconds

post.summary: Confirm and apply a Sign-in Method change

409.description: Sign-in Method belongs to another User

put.summary: Set the signed-in User's Profile Photo
put.description: The key comes from POST /api/v1/uploads/presign with kind image and writeProtocol conditional-v1, after the file reached storage. A second photo replaces the first. Sending the current photo's key again changes nothing.

400.description: UPLOAD_NOT_AVAILABLE (not this User's unused fenced image upload), UPLOAD_OBJECT_INVALID (stored file missing, empty, over 5 MB or of another type), or VALIDATION_FAILED

403.description: The User is suspended or their deletion is scheduled

409.description: UPLOAD_ALREADY_ATTACHED, with details.reason UPLOAD_ATTACHED_TO_LISTING (the upload belongs to a Listing) or UPLOAD_PREPARING (another request is still setting it; send the same key again later)

delete.summary: Remove the signed-in User's Profile Photo
delete.description: The Assigned Avatar shows again; avatarIndex never changes. Succeeds when the User has no photo.

403.description: The User is suspended or their deletion is scheduled

post.summary: Request a code to confirm a Listing contact phone
post.description: Answers confirmed, and sends nothing, for the seller's sign-in phone or a number the seller confirmed in the last 7 days. Otherwise sends one SMS code. Counts against the same per-number and per-IP budgets as sign-in.

200.description: Number already usable, or code sent

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED, or RATE_LIMITED with details (RateLimitedDetails): reason destination_limit, ip_limit or backoff, and retryInSeconds

403.description: FORBIDDEN: details.reason USER_SUSPENDED, or the account deletion is scheduled

post.summary: Confirm a Listing contact phone with its code
post.description: Checks the newest contact-phone code this seller requested for the number. A confirmation restarts the 7 days.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_OTP with details (InvalidOtpDetails), OTP_LOCKED, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_ALREADY_USED or OTP_NOT_FOUND

403.description: FORBIDDEN: details.reason USER_SUSPENDED, or the account deletion is scheduled

get.summary: List the seller's reusable confirmed contact phones
get.description: Newest confirmation first. Leaves out the sign-in phone, which the app reads from GET /api/v1/me.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: details.reason USER_SUSPENDED, or the account deletion is scheduled

post.summary: Request a code to delete the account holding a phone or email
post.description: Public. Answers the same way whether or not a User holds the value.

400.description: Validation error, or RATE_LIMITED with details (RateLimitedDetails): reason destination_limit, ip_limit or backoff, and retryInSeconds

post.summary: Confirm a deletion code and start the 30-day grace period
post.description: Public. A valid code for a value no User holds gets the same 204 and changes nothing.

400.description: Validation error, or INVALID_OTP for any wrong, expired, used, locked, or missing code

post.summary: Signal an explicitly viewed Listing detail
post.description: Public. Send only after a loaded, focused, foreground detail remains visible for two seconds. Installation identity takes precedence over optional authentication. No identity, owner/admin, inactive, deleted or duplicate daily signals do not increment. Collection is disabled until retention and disclosure gates pass.

204.description: Signal accepted without revealing whether it counted

get.summary: Search brands and models in any spelling
get.description: Matches Russian, English and Turkmen spellings with Cyrillic–Latin transliteration and one forgiven typo. Understands year tokens ("camry 2018", "лексус 2014-2019", "2018").

200.description: Ranked brand and model results with the parsed year range

get.summary: Count listings matching public feed filters
Model-level counts for a selected brand
Brand-level listing counts for the current filters

400.description: UPLOAD_OBJECT_INVALID identifies details.key; publish also identifies details.photoId. Other validation refusals use ErrorResponse.
